ResearchProjectDef.label: Whispers hybrid analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Formalize the study of Michael's abandoned blind predator hybrids: their extreme auditory compensation, irreversible Human/Iratus-derived restructuring, and fog-producing neck-gill system. This research forms the prerequisite for derived acoustic-sensory and biological mist technologies.

customUnlockTexts.li: Unlocks the WNG prerequisite path for hybrid-derived hearing and passive, continuously emitting mist-gland implants.
